topography.project_purpose: YieldFi is an active Yield Aggregator and capital-markets / asset-management platform focused on tokenized yield-vault issuance and distribution. Its current V3 positioning includes curated yield products, institutionally managed vaults, proof-of-reserves and exposure reporting, transparency metrics, and migration support for legacy vault products.
topography.relationship_narrative: V1 and V2 families share governance infrastructure through Manager contracts and rely on bridges for cross-chain asset movement. The YieldFi vaults likely interact with yield-bearing tokens from both versions to aggregate user deposits.
